value.rationale: The result gives an exact finite-sample calibration for the smallest nontrivial weighted HMP problem that the modern literature explicitly identifies as requiring threshold adjustment. It also yields a structural design fact—equal weights uniquely maximize independent-null size inflation at every threshold—rather than merely recomputing one number. The \(5\%\) example quantifies the practical gap and supplies an exact corrected cutoff.
